name.ja: 1/1000国連宇宙海軍 連合宇宙艦隊セット２
name.en: 1/1000 United Nations Space Navy Combined Space Fleet Set 2

description.ja: • 連合宇宙艦隊の巡洋艦２隻、駆逐艦２隻のカラーパターンセットが登場。
description.en: • A color pattern set of two cruisers and two destroyers of the United Starfleet is now available.

description.ja: • 巡洋艦８種類、駆逐艦12種類の登録No.船体名のデカールが付属。同型艦をそれぞれ再現できる。
description.en: • Decals with registration numbers and hull names for 8 types of cruisers and 12 types of destroyers are included. Each ship of the same type can be reproduced.

description.ja: • 同スケールのコスモゼロが付属。
description.en: • Cosmo Zero of the same scale is included.
